Lists the assessments available to the API client's client

Lists the client's report runs from the last 7 days, newest first, capped at 500.
Runs started by the API client or its owner user are always listed.
With permission to view others' report runs, scheduled runs and runs started by others are also listed, where the API client can run those reports on all of the run's tenants.

post.description:
Queues a run of one or more reports for tenants in the caller's tenant scope.
Each requested report type needs its run permissions on every requested tenant, and every requested tenant must hold the license that report type needs. Otherwise the request fails with 403.

get.description: Lists the rendered outputs of a finished report run, for tenants in the caller's tenant scope. A collated output is listed only when the scope covers every tenant the run targeted

parameters.name: reportRunId
